effect.name: Classificação de pixels (NV)
effect.desc: Ordena as faixas de pixels claros (ou de matiz, saturação…) acima do limiar, em qualquer ângulo — o Pixel Sort do Node Video.
effect.desc-en: Sorts the runs of pixels above the threshold (by brightness, hue, saturation…) at any angle — Node Video's Pixel Sort.
